name: Long March 3B
tagline: China's GTO workhorse — Chang'e lunar landers + most Chinese comsats
description: Three-stage liquid-hypergolic launcher (UDMH/N2O4 on the lower stages, LH2/LOX on the third) with four side-mounted strap-on boosters. Lifts ~12 t to LEO / ~5.5 t to GTO from Xichang Satellite Launch Centre. The maiden flight (1996-02-15, Intelsat 708) failed catastrophically due to a guidance-loop fault and killed villagers downrange; the redesigned vehicle has since flown well over 100 successful missions and is the standard launcher for Chang'e lunar exploration.
best_known_for: China's GTO workhorse — Chang'e 3 / 4 lunar landers + most commercial comsats from Xichang
